run_detector_training: run the train detector script with a config file path and optional work directory
run_distributed_training: run distributed detector training using pytorch slurm or mpi launcher options
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume detector training from an existing checkpoint file using the resume-from flag
override_config_options: override config settings during detector training using the cfg-options argument
set_random_seed_training: set a random seed and deterministic mode for reproducible detector training runs
